_doc: mu. music edit for the Down With Hunger explainer (music supervisor). One track: 'Onion Capers' by Kevin MacLeod (CC BY 4.0), 105.0016 BPM measured, Rubber Band stretched to the picture's 104 BPM (ratio 0.99046, about 1 %). Source grid: downbeats at 0.8764 + 2.28568*n s (arrange.py, phase confidence 1.06, residual 3.2 ms, 100 % inliers; the 4-bar F G C F phrases change chord exactly on these bar lines). Re-cut 2026-11-01 for the 27-line script (163.2 s): every 'at' is a film bar line (n*2.30769 s) except the button; the drop on film bar 26 (60.0 s) under l11. Re-cut again for the Voice Studio narration (165.03 s): scene starts moved by whole half-bars, so segments 4-10 were re-placed on film bars 19, 23, 27, 40, 56, 64 and the button on the stamp at 161.09. Re-cut for the Omid narration (138.97 s): list groove 8 bars, breakdown 6, rebuild+drop on bar 22, tour groove B1 only, B3, ending on bar 53.

segments.label: COLD OPEN src bars 0-3 (A1a, the track's lightest bars) -> film bars 0-3 (0-9.23), under the title card and bubbles; -2 dB
LIST GROOVE src bars 16-23 (A2: F G C F x2) -> film bars 4-11 (9.23-27.69), half a bar after the 8.08 wipe; splice F (src 3) -> F (src 16)

BREAKDOWN src bars 4-7 (A1b, light) -> film bars 15-18 (34.62-43.85), the music thins half a bar before the 35.77 wipe into 'the problem'; splice F (src 35) -> F (src 4); -6 dB [Omid re-cut]: film bars 12-15, half a bar before the problem wipe at 28.85
BREAKDOWN cont. src bars 1-2 (A1a: G C) -> film bars 16-17 [Omid re-cut]; resolves into the rebuild F

REBUILD src bars 36-39 (A3b: F G C F) -> film bars 22-25 (50.77-60.0), on the 50.77 wipe into 'the idea', under l09-l10 and the logos dropping into the pot; splice F (src 3) -> F (src 36); -3 dB [Voice Studio re-cut: now film bars 23-26 (53.08-62.31), on the wipe into the idea] [Omid re-cut]: film bars 18-21 (41.54-50.77), leading into the idea wipe at 43.85

DROP src bars 24-36 (B2, the track's loudest B section with its +2 dB rise on the downbeat, then A3a and A3b's first bar) -> film bars 26-38 (60.0-90.0); the drop downbeat on film bar 26 = 60.000 s: 193 ms after the pot burst / l11 at 59.807, 127 ms before the protester stamp 60.127; splice F (src 39) -> Bb (src 24) = the native IV -> bVII entrance of every B section [Voice Studio re-cut: drop now on film bar 27 (62.31), under l11] [Omid re-cut]: drop on film bar 22 (50.77), 0.15 s before l11; runs 15 bars (src 24-38)
TOUR GROOVE src bars 8-15 (B1 only) -> film bars 37-44 [Omid re-cut]

TOUR GROOVE src bars 40-47 (B3, ends on C with the track's loudest bars) -> film bars 55-62 (126.92-145.38), across the 131.54 wipe into the shop; splice F (src 23) -> Bb (src 40) native B entrance [Omid re-cut]: film bars 45-52 (103.85-122.31)

ENDING src bars 50-55 (A4, the track's own last phrase) -> film bar 63 (145.38), on the wipe into 'surprise'; splice C (src 47) -> C (src 50) same chord; ends on the track's own stop after beat 3 of src bar 55 (music silent from film ~158.8, under the end of l25) [Voice Studio re-cut: film bar 64 (147.69); last bar shortened so the stop-time still falls before the stamp] [Omid re-cut]: starts on the surprise wipe, film bar 53 (122.31)

BUTTON: the track's final hit as its own segment, its attack on the brick placard slam close:stamp:0 = 159.846 s (a 1.05 s comic stop-time after the track's own stop), ringing out under the 2.60 s end-card hold (tail_fade 2.0) [Voice Studio re-cut: stamp now at 161.09] [Omid re-cut]: stamp at 135.10
segments.qa_ok: a separate button segment placed on the picture (the slam), not on a bar line; the 1.3 s silence before it is the track's own stop-time lengthened on purpose
